narrative.intro: Bechtel Plant Machinery obligated $2.1B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Bechtel Plant Machinery won 7 awards with an average award size of $295M. Bechtel Plant Machinery obligations are down 3.6% year over year. Bechtel Plant Machinery has moved through a multi-year funding pattern: FY21 obligations were $2B, FY22 obligations were $2.1B, FY23 obligations were $1.4B, FY24 obligations were $2.2B, FY25 obligations were $2.1B, and FY26 obligations are $2.1B. Bechtel Plant Machinery current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is in progress. Bechtel Plant Machinery figures here are contract obligations except where a table explicitly shows award-value or total contract value. Bechtel Plant Machinery shows stability around the $2.1B level in recent years, and the average award size reflects large, program-level awards rather than many small buys. Bechtel Plant Machinery performance across fiscal years highlights where obligations dipped and recovered, which matters for contractors and agencies tracking partner capacity and program continuity.
